children.name: Lead
children.text: An AI-driven control interface and lever-operation optimisation for the next-generation ship bridge — tested with Finnlines captains and crew.

children.name: Value
children.text: UX/UI & HMI — energy, alarm, AI interaction

children.name: Subtitle
children.text: A sea trial before the steel is cut

children.name: Lead
children.text: A full-mission ship simulator turned into a pre-sales web tool: a sales engineer and a ship owner compare propulsion set-ups in one standard manoeuvre — in time and euros.

children.name: Lead
children.text: Web portals and machinery UI kept separate libraries. CoreDS unites them under one guideline — shared principles, token naming and component specs, shipped as React components in Storybook.

children.name: Subtitle
children.text: Energy SCADA for a fuel-cell data center

children.name: Lead
children.text: System and information architecture for a PCFC-powered data center, from site overview down to a single cabinet — prototyped in React: data in → live dashboard → alarms.
